name: Dark Heart
summary: At Camp Mojache, Talo Thornhoof seeks Edana Hatetalon’s heart to end the hatred she spreads.

sections.title: The Harpy Queen
sections.body: Edana Hatetalon rules the Northspring brood in ruins to the west. Talo calls her pure evil and says she feels nothing but hatred for everyone. He has heard her heart is made of crystal. He asks you to face her and bring back her dark heart, so her hatred can be stopped.

sections.title: A Summons
sections.body: Talo has heard that harpies carry a horn. Sound it near the Hatetalon stones in the northern part of the ruins, and it is said to draw Edana out. Talo relishes the thought that death, rather than her kin, will answer her call.

sections.title: On Your Return
sections.body: Talo Thornhoof is certain Edana Hatetalon is gone for good. He will keep her heart in memory of what you did.

faq.answer: Edana Hatetalon rules the Northspring harpies in the western ruins. Talo calls her pure evil and says she feels only hatred. He has heard her heart is crystal.

faq.q: How can Edana Hatetalon be summoned?
faq.answer: Talo has heard that harpies carry a horn. Sound it near the Hatetalon stones in the northern part of the ruins, and it is said to call the queen.

faq.q: Who gives the hunt for Edana Hatetalon?
faq.answer: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache gives the hunt for Edana Hatetalon.

faq.q: Why does Talo Thornhoof want Edana's heart?
faq.answer: Talo wants to stop the hatred Edana spreads over the land. He asks you to bring back her dark heart.
